name: prism
description: Prism: give every project in the ZCode sidebar its own color, icon and display name. Right-click a project (or its '...' menu) to personalize; self-heals after app updates.

description_i18n.en: Prism: give every project in the ZCode sidebar its own color, icon and display name. Right-click a project (or its '...' menu) to personalize; self-heals after app updates.
description_i18n.zh-CN: Prism（棱镜）：为 ZCode 侧边栏中的每个项目赋予专属颜色、图标与显示名，右键项目（或其「…」菜单）即可个性化；应用更新后自动恢复生效。
